description.de: Selbstdarstellung als eine HTML-Datei, Thema für Thema und wahlweise auf Deutsch oder Englisch (language): ein Shell-Schritt misst Fakten im Repository und schnürt je Thema ein Paket aus Konzeptseiten und README, ein KI-Aufruf je Thema textet nur die Aussage, ein Shell-Schritt setzt Rahmen, Diagramme und Datenfolien und prüft (CHECK: OK). Ziel: docs/presentation/index.html (en) bzw. de.html (de). Benötigt dieses Repository.
description.en: Self-presentation as one HTML file, topic by topic, in German or English (language): a shell step measures facts in the repository and bundles one packet per topic from concept pages and README, one AI call per topic writes only the message, a shell step sets frame, diagrams and data slides and checks them (CHECK: OK). Target: docs/presentation/index.html (en) or de.html (de). Requires this repository.

author: MySuricates
instructions: Text for a presentation built from measured facts. The AI blocks write no files and answer with JSON only. No commits, pushes, API calls or TODO changes.

config.label: Measure facts + bundle topic packets
config.command:
set -euo pipefail
set -- {{ repo_root }}; ROOT="${1:-.}"
set -- {{ language }}; PRES_LANG="${1:-en}"
set -- {{ workflow_run_id }}; RUN_ID="${1:-manual}"
set -- {{ work_dir }}; WORK="${1:-reports/presentation}/$RUN_ID"
set -- {{ themes }}; THEMES="${1:-all}"
set -- {{ ops_facts }}; OPS="${1:-}"
set -- {{ audience }}; AUDIENCE="${1:-}"
set -- {{ core_ideas }}; CORE_IDEAS="${1:-}"
set -- {{ big_idea }}; BIG_IDEA="${1:-}"
python3 "$ROOT/scripts/concepts/presentation.py" facts --root "$ROOT" --work "$WORK" --language "$PRES_LANG" \
  --themes "$THEMES" --ops-facts "$OPS" --audience "$AUDIENCE" --core-ideas "$CORE_IDEAS" --big-idea "$BIG_IDEA"

config.label: Per topic: write the message (one AI call)
config.command:
You write the text for EXACTLY ONE topic of a presentation about MySuricates. Topic: {{ theme }}. Slide language: {{ language }}.

First read the file {{ work_dir }}/{{ workflow_run_id }}/packets/{{ theme }}.txt — it holds the language rule, the audience, the binding guiding idea, the measured values, concept pages and further material for this topic. Read nothing else unless a claim can only be backed that way.

IMPORTANT: Do NOT write any files. Answer only with a single JSON object as text. Frame, diagrams, data slides, numbers and layout are produced deterministically by the next workflow step — you only supply the message.

## Rules
- Place the topic in "the one idea" from the packet: which point of the cycle (section "The cycle of the deck") does it occupy? It does not have to be stated, but the slides should make it felt.
- 1 to 2 slides. Slide 1 carries the idea as a clear statement and says what one gets from it. Slide 2 (optional) shows concretely how the system implements it — ideally with a tangible example of what someone does with it.
- Tone: confident and factual. Show what is there and what it brings. No superlatives, no marketing — but no list of shortcomings either: no slide and no entry "where it falls short", no section for weaknesses. A limitation only where it is needed for understanding, and then as half a sentence. The classification (research project, one installation) is bundled on the closing slide — do not repeat it.
- Write every text field in the language given in the packet section "Language of the slides".
- Use only keys that appear literally in the section "Measured values" — do not invent any. A text field with an unknown key is dropped.
- NEVER write a measured value yourself: reference it as [[key]] from the section "Measured values" (e.g. "[[ops_steps_shell]] of [[ops_steps_total]] steps"). The renderer inserts the value and reports every other number.
- Measured values show what is built and running. Do not overstretch them (stock is not impact), but do not play them down either.
- Material from the repository supplies thoughts, not quotations: take them over, do not quote them word for word, no links, no paths.
- Short: title max. 70 characters, lead max. 200, items[].head max. 40, items[].text max. 140. Inline allowed: **bold** and `code`.

## Layouts
statement (title = one strong sentence, lead) · bullets (title, lead, items 2–4) · cards (title, lead, items 2–4) · quote (title = verbatim quote from a concept page, lead = source)
Optional "data_leads": one sentence per data slide of this topic (possible keys: cost, blocks, connect, providers, guardrails, modules) that says what to look at.

## Output format
{"theme": "{{ theme }}", "slides": [{"layout": "statement", "title": "...", "lead": "...", "note": "speaker note"}], "data_leads": {"cost": "..."}}

config.label: Render + check
config.command:
set -euo pipefail
set -- {{ repo_root }}; ROOT="${1:-.}"
set -- {{ language }}; PRES_LANG="${1:-en}"
set -- {{ workflow_run_id }}; RUN_ID="${1:-manual}"
set -- {{ work_dir }}; WORK="${1:-reports/presentation}/$RUN_ID"
set -- {{ output_file }}; OUT="${1:-}"
set -- {{ block.story.output }}; STORY="${1:-}"
printf '%s\n' "$STORY" > "$WORK/story-raw.txt"
python3 "$ROOT/scripts/concepts/presentation.py" render --root "$ROOT" --work "$WORK" --language "$PRES_LANG" \
  --story-file "$WORK/story-raw.txt" --out "$OUT"
